findings.before: Some contributions were requested; others were the helper’s own initiative. Some really solved the recipient’s problems; others mainly met the helper’s need to “be useful.” Putting them all in the same ledger conceals their differences.
findings.after: Some contributions were requested; others were the helper’s own initiative. Some really solved the recipient’s problems; others mainly met the helper’s need to feel they “must be useful.” Putting them all in the same ledger conceals their differences.
findings.issue: Restore the internal must-be-useful compulsion, not simply usefulness.
